safety_verdicts.content: Patient has needed to use the blue inhaler twice a day.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states patient currently needs blue inhaler twice daily; Generated does not document current frequency of use as twice daily.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient currently needs the blue (reliever) inhaler twice daily can underestimate current asthma symptom burden and degree of poor control, which may delay appropriate escalation (e.g., timely review, steroids) during an exacerbation. This is more clinically significant than simple background history because it affects current severity assessment.
